front.title: A Framework for Agent Discovery in DAWN

abstract.t: This document describes a two-layer reference architecture for discovering the minimum public information needed to reach AI agents. The Local Discovery Plane obtains discovery information within an administrative domain through mDNS/DNS-SD or infrastructure-assisted discovery. The Federation Plane uses DNS as its baseline for cross- domain discovery: Federation Gateways apply export policy, publish permitted information in independently administered DNS zones, and retrieve, validate, and cache remote information on demand. The framework also provides non-DNS mechanisms and mixed-mode deployments on the Federation Plane which can complement the baseline with proactive distribution, recipient-specific sharing, and directory lookup.
